info.name: Oxylabs Web Intelligence APIs
info.description:
Oxylabs provides web scraping and data extraction APIs including the Web Scraper API (Realtime and Push-Pull), the Dashboard API for usage and statistics, and the Residential Public API for sub-user and stats management.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oxylabs Developer Support

request.description: Submit a job to the Web Scraper API. Use the Realtime server to receive results synchronously, or the Push-Pull server to receive results asynchronously via callback or polling.
